M-CB-T-001.mitigation: Enable Secure Boot with cryptographic signature verification of the boot chain

M-CB-T-002.mitigation: Apply firmware readback protection (RDP Level 1/2 or equivalent OTP mechanism)

M-CB-T-003.mitigation: Encrypt FPGA bitstream with device-specific key to prevent readback and IP theft

M-CB-T-004.mitigation: Verify supply chain integrity — source chips exclusively from authorized distributors with traceability

M-CB-I-001.mitigation: Apply side-channel countermeasures (power analysis protection, timing attack resistance)

M-CB-I-002.mitigation: Store device keys and certificates in dedicated hardware security module (TPM, Secure Element, HSM)

M-CB-E-001.mitigation: Lock or disable JTAG/SWD debug interface via OTP fuse before production release

M-CB-E-002.mitigation: Apply RDP Level 2 — full JTAG disable with automatic mass-erase on tamper attempt

M-CB-SCA-001.mitigation: Apply power analysis countermeasures — use constant-time algorithms, randomized clock, power filter or noise injection (NIST SP 800-193)

M-CB-SCA-002.mitigation: Apply electromagnetic shielding and countermeasures against EM emission analysis — shield package, use metal lid, route sensitive signals on inner layers

M-CB-SCA-003.mitigation: Use constant-time cryptographic implementations — eliminate data-dependent branches and memory access patterns

M-CB-SCA-004.mitigation: Apply potting compound or conformal coating to security-critical PCB areas — prevent physical probing of bus traces between security elements
